foundations.rationale: The timed preview workflow lets people inspect and test work directly, and specifies when their local preview closes.

copy.rationale: Contributor instructions describe preview timing, conversational sign-off, issue status and live-site verification. Attribution examples identify unavailable details.

interface.rationale: Changes cover local developer tooling, contributor instructions and templates.

bar-and-exports.rationale: No renderer, bar logic, preview or export implementation changed.

media.rationale: The documentation change introduces no media or contextual brand application.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: No institutional assets, asset permissions or brand approval requests changed.

governance.rationale: Maintain the canonical cross-service workflow and references, including the merge and release checklist. Existing official source routes, coverage, hashes, conflict register and required review gate apply to later site changes.

existingConflicts.disposition: Recorded in references/brand_conflicts.md. These instructions introduce no new use of the disputed treatments.

approvalRationale: Contributor guidance and local server lifecycle changes introduce no institutional artwork, assets or generator output.
publicationScope: Owner-authorized repository PR and merge for contributor documentation, the PR template and local preview server tooling.

checks.name: brand-policy
checks.evidence: Local guard validates the source corpus, required area coverage and changed-file fingerprint.

checks.name: unit-tests
checks.evidence: Local Jest run passed all 1,298 tests across 107 suites against current main including merged Waveform PR #228.

checks.name: local-preview-command
checks.evidence: Served root and /generator/solid/ on loopback and verified the listening socket closed at expiry. An actual request for merged PR #227 closed the server before expiry. Simulated unmerged and rate-limited responses, network errors and a stalled request left the independent expiry active. Invalid arguments failed validation.

checks.name: commit-trailer-example
checks.evidence: git interpret-trailers --parse recognized both grouped AI-Assistance example records.

checks.name: rendered-ui
checks.evidence: No generator UI changes. Route checks verified local developer preview startup and HTTP responses.

checks.name: preview-export-parity
checks.evidence: No changes to runtime rendering, geometry or export behavior.

checks.name: release-checklist
checks.evidence: Checked instructions and template against the active main ruleset, current Pages deployment, and GitHub default-branch issue closing documentation. Verified internal anchors and diff formatting.

checks.name: user acceptance
checks.evidence: This change concerns contributor documentation and local tooling. The owner authorized the merge. Generator visual acceptance does not apply.
